name: Hoodie_Hauler
brief: Heather-grey zip hoodie, untucked and hanging over charcoal joggers (cuffed at the ankle). Hood down on the back, red zip line + red drawstrings with tips, kangaroo pocket. White chunky sneakers with red laces.

name: Denim_Overalls
brief: Blue denim overalls: trousers + bib panel on the chest + two shoulder straps with brass buttons, worn over a yellow/white horizontally striped tee (short sleeves). Contrast orange stitching lines. Tan work boots.

name: Gym_Buddy
brief: Lime tank top (no sleeves, deep armholes) hanging over black athletic shorts with a white side stripe. White wristbands, orange running shoes, skin-colour leg covers below the shorts.

name: Comfy_Pajamas
brief: Light-blue button-up pajama shirt with white polka dots and a white piped collar, hanging over matching polka-dot pajama trousers. Fuzzy pink slippers with a little pom-pom on each.

name: Parcel_Courier
brief: Moving-day courier: brown polo shirt tucked into brown shorts with a black belt, yellow box-logo patch on the chest and yellow collar trim. Skin-colour leg covers, white crew socks, black sneakers. A small clipboard clipped to the belt.

name: Green_Thumb
brief: Gardener: sage-green bib apron with a big front pocket (trowel handle sticking out) over a yellow tee, khaki shorts, green rubber garden boots. Leaf print on the apron pocket.

name: Splash_Painter
brief: House painter: white painter's overalls covered in colourful paint splatters (red, blue, yellow, green drips) over a blue tee, grey sneakers with paint dots. Paint brush in a chest pocket.

name: Lumberjack
brief: Red/black buffalo-check flannel shirt with rolled sleeves (forearms bare), hanging over blue jeans held by red suspenders, tall brown leather lace-up boots.

name: Mail_Carrier
brief: Light-blue short-sleeve shirt with navy shoulder patches, tucked into navy shorts, crossbody leather mail satchel resting on the hip (strap over one shoulder, envelopes peeking out), white socks, black shoes.

name: Barista
brief: Black long-sleeve tee with pushed-up sleeves, tan canvas bib apron with leather neck strap and a coffee-bean logo on the pocket, dark jeans, white sneakers. Pen and small towel tucked in the apron.

name: Shadow_Ninja
brief: Black ninja gi with wrap-front collar (visible overlap line), red sash belt with a knot and two hanging tails, loose dark trousers bound with criss-cross wraps on the shins, split-toe tabi boots. Red neck scarf with two long tails flowing behind, short sword (wakizashi) across the lower back, two shuriken on the belt.

name: Desert_Cowboy
brief: Red bandana tied at the neck, brown suede vest with fringe over a cream shirt, jeans with a big oval gold belt buckle, brown leather chaps over the jeans fronts, cowboy boots with spurs, coiled lasso on the belt.

name: Surgeon
brief: Teal scrubs (V-neck top + trousers) under a long white lab coat that hangs open at the front over the trousers to the knee (lapels, chest pocket with pens, two hip pockets, back vent). Stethoscope around the neck, ID badge, white clogs.

name: Speed_Racer
brief: One-piece red racing suit with two white racing stripes down the front and legs, sponsor patches (painted), padded collar, black gloves with white knuckle pads, black racing boots, checkered-flag trim on the cuffs and belt.

name: Deep_Diver
brief: Navy full wetsuit with yellow panels down the sides and on the shoulders, weight belt with lead blocks, twin yellow air tanks with a valve on the back, dive mask hanging on the chest from its strap, regulator hose, long yellow fins on the feet.

name: Noir_Detective
brief: Long double-breasted tan trench coat hanging to the knee over grey trousers (belted, buckle, epaulettes, popped collar, buttons), dark-red plaid scarf, polished brown shoes, magnifying glass in the belt.

name: Skater_Kid
brief: Oversized white graphic tee (big teal/red flame logo) hanging over baggy grey cargo pants with side pockets, chunky red high-top skate shoes, chain wallet hanging from the belt loop, skateboard strapped on the back.

name: Jungle_Explorer
brief: Khaki safari shirt with two flap chest pockets and epaulettes hanging over khaki shorts, big canvas backpack with a rolled bedroll on top, binoculars on a strap across the chest, knee-high socks and hiking boots.

name: Rock_Star
brief: Black leather biker jacket (open, silver zips, studded shoulders) over a white tee with a pink lightning bolt, ripped black skinny jeans (painted rips), studded belt, black boots with buckles, pink electric guitar slung on the back.

name: Samurai_Warlord
brief: Lacquered red armour: chest plate made of horizontal lames laced with gold cord, gold crest emblem on the chest, big flat shoulder plates (sode) on the upper arms, armoured throat guard collar, layered hanging tassets (kusazuri) over wide indigo hakama trousers, armoured shin guards, katana at the hip.

name: Frost_Viking
brief: Mail tunic hanging over brown wool trousers with criss-cross leg wraps, thick white fur mantle around the shoulders, leather belt with a knotwork gold buckle, fur boots, round painted shield on the back, hand axe in the belt.

name: Sun_Pharaoh
brief: White pleated linen kilt (shendyt) with a gold belt and a jewelled front panel, sheer white top, huge jewelled usekh collar (concentric gold / turquoise / lapis bands) over the shoulders, gold arm cuffs, gold sandals.

name: Ice_Mage
brief: Floor-length ice-blue A-line robe with white fur trim at the hem and cuffs, snowflake pattern, frosted silver sash, wide bell sleeves, jagged ice-crystal spikes on both shoulders, white boots. Robe must use slit panels like the Wizard.

name: Mecha_Pilot
brief: Bulky white armoured pilot suit with orange panels and glowing cyan lines, chest plate with a glowing round core, chunky shoulder and knee plates, armoured boots, compact jetpack with two thruster nozzles on the back.

name: Royal_Guard
brief: Scarlet tunic hanging over black trousers with a red side stripe, two rows of gold buttons, white cross-belts with a brass plate, gold collar and cuff braid, gold epaulettes, white gloves, polished black boots.

name: Court_Jester
brief: Harlequin diamond-pattern tunic (purple / gold) with a zig-zag pointed hem with a bell on each point, hanging over two-tone leggings (left leg purple, right leg gold), big white ruffled collar, curly toe shoes with bells.

name: Dragon_Knight
brief: Obsidian scale armour (scale pattern) with blood-red accents, dragon-head spiked pauldrons, red tabard panels hanging front and back over armoured legs, clawed gauntlets, big folded bat-like dragon wings on the back, spiked dragon tail.

name: Seraph
brief: Radiant white A-line robe with gold trim and gold sash (slit panels like the Wizard), gold shoulder guards, gold arm bands, huge layered feathered angel wings spread behind, gold sandals.

name: Neon_Ronin
brief: Matte-black techwear samurai: angular armour plates with glowing neon cyan + magenta light strips, high neon-lined collar, layered tassets over hakama-cut trousers, energy katana with a glowing blade on the back.

name: Phoenix_Emperor
brief: Crimson imperial robe with gold flame pattern rising from the hem (A-line, slit panels), gold phoenix collar, gold bracers, a fan of fiery phoenix feathers / flame wings behind the shoulders (orange to yellow).
